spawn_multi_process: spawn multiple processes on a single node to run a test method across ranks
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local single-rank distributed process group with a specified backend
ForkedPdb_set_trace: attach a debugger to a forked multiprocessing child process during a distributed run
PGConfig: create a process group configuration dataclass with backend, world size, and group parameters
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank then launch a test method in a spawned process
